resolvedQuestions: How can dispatchToolCall be made transport-neutral and shared by the CLI and the MCP server while argument errors return as CLI results?
What CLI command surface, JSON output contract, preview handling, startup cost, and shared data folder satisfy direct terminal use?
How should the plugin and a standalone package expose the CLI to Claude Code and other terminal agents while preserving dist-relative assets?
How can the skill rely on the CLI alone while the Claude Project stays on MCP and the mirrored reference pairs stay byte-identical?
How should the naming and placement gate be hardened so a batch gets confirmed names and one place, and what is the ranked change list for the four phases?

keyFindings.text: Transport-neutral dispatch is live: dispatchTool takes a definitions map, a ToolContext, a name and unknown args, returns a discriminated DispatchOutcome, and imports no transport value beyond the type CallToolResult.
Argument errors return as results on the CLI (INVALID_INPUT JSON plus exit 2) and stay protocol errors on MCP (McpError MethodNotFound and InvalidParams), the split each audience needs.
A separate CLI entry exists with a self-run guard, while runtime/src/index.ts:126 still executes void main() at module scope, so importing the MCP entry would start a stdio server.

Tool argv never reaches loadConfig: configTokens emits only --allowed-dir and --output-dir tokens, and tool arguments travel through --args, --args-file or stdin, while parseArguments still turns bare tokens into allowed-root candidates.
Exit codes form a stable table: 0 success, 1 tool failure, 2 usage or dispatch error, 3 startup failure, 130 and 143 on SIGINT and SIGTERM.
Signal cleanup reaps ffmpeg children and tracked temp paths through terminateAll and registerCleanupPath before exiting with 128 plus the signal number.
The dispatch packet's path instruction is stale: the folder is runtime/ with the rename staged in the nested repository, not mcp server/, so this lineage cites runtime/ throughout.
The command surface is list, describe, health and tool commands, and running the built CLI confirmed exactly 40 tools with media_health first and the hardened schema fields present in describe.
list prints name, title and description for the 40 ALL_TOOLS entries and describe adds annotations plus z.toJSONSchema of the listed schema, needing no dependency beyond the existing zod.
One JSON argument source per call (--args, --args-file, or stdin when not a TTY) with mutual exclusion, and individual tool flags are deliberately not accepted.
stdout receives exactly the structuredContent object, diagnostics go to stderr, and the exit code distinguishes tool failure from usage and startup failure.

The preview lands as a file: the CLI-only PreviewSink returns previewPath in structuredContent instead of a base64 block, and the sink writes dataDir/previews atomically, while MCP keeps the inline image.

Startup cost measured warm: 0.02 seconds baseline, 0.06 for the sharp import, 0.13 for the full tool graph, and 0.11 for node dist/cli.js list end to end, so no build-time schema manifest is needed at this scale.
The persistent cache landed as dataDir/cache/probes.json storing binary resolutions and encoder and filter lists keyed by path, size, mtime and version, constructed per call from config.dataDir.
One shared MEDIA_EDITOR_DATA_DIR is preserved end to end, so media_setup_ffmpeg then media_health work across separate CLI calls, and cache and previews live in the same folder.
The argument parse is a plain z.object safeParse, so a mistyped JSON key is stripped silently with no warning, which is more likely on a CLI than on a schema-driven host.

The plugin build ships and checks the CLI: it fails when server/dist/cli.js is absent and writes bin/media-editor plus bin/media-editor.cmd, with the shim resolving its own real path before running the bundled CLI.
The plugin manifest still carries the mcpServers block pointing at server/dist/index.js, so the fixed-decision flip to no MCP server is an open item for phase 005.
The standalone route is declared as media-editor-mcp and media-editor bins in a private package, so other terminal agents run node dist/cli.js or install locally, with no npm publication in scope.
Bundle staging stages dist, assets and licenses whole, so dist/cli.js rides the existing per-platform bundle under the 150 MB limit with no new staging rule.
Official docs: CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT resolves inline in skill Markdown and is not present in the Bash tool environment, so a skill can carry the plugin-root invocation as a literal line.
Official docs: a plugin bin folder is on the Bash tool PATH while enabled, and claude.ai and Cowork do not install a plugin with that directory, the recorded cost of the bare media-editor route.
The plugin ships the skill by copying sk-media-editor into claude-plugin/skills and failing on any difference, and plugin skills load namespaced as /plugin-name:skill-name.

The dist layout must stay because server-info.ts loads ../../package.json through createRequire and font-path.ts resolves ../../assets/fonts through import.meta.url, so a single-file bundle would break both.
The skill is still MCP-first because 005 has not started, and references/cli.md does not exist yet, while the target state is written in the 005 spec.
All seven declared mirror pairs are byte-identical as of this reading, verified with cmp -s, with router-contract.md the declared unmirrored exception held equal by the differential.
The route change is media_cli_available() as the first branch of choose_route, bound rather than reimplemented so the kernel copy at systems.py:1680 stays byte-identical modulo comments.
A fourth host state and a third binding are needed in differential.py, and no schema change follows because route is not a contract field.
rule_parity.py carries five verbatim tools-first phrases with min_pairs 5, so a CLI-first rewrite must place the new sentences in paired files and raise min_pairs in the same change.
The SRO-001 and PRO-001 twin should assert the deliverable while the route assertion moves to the unpaired sets, which already list SED-004 and PED-001.
The Sync Loop declaration needs three edits: cli.md into unmirrored_sources, the header statement at 1290 rewritten, and the router statement at 1680 with its key.

keyFindings.text: The CLI runtime phrase in the playbook must be reworded to the Claude Code skill wherever it means the runtime, keeping CLI for the executable.

The kernel gate landed in five places: File Naming, Export Protocol with the subfolder-then-targetFolder flow, ALWAYS 9, ESCALATE 1 now firing on a request that will write a file, and Strict Sequence steps 3 and 4.
The batch question template landed as a dedicated section that takes the place of the comprehensive question and is still one question, mirrored byte-identically.
The field text no longer presents omission as normal and adds targetFolderField naming an existing numbered folder exactly as an earlier call returned it, never with subfolder false.
Batch-aware placement landed as targetFolder with three named failures and a dispatcher conflict check, while image_convert stays single-input per operator decision OD-2.
maxBytes landed for jpeg, webp and avif only with a bounded quality search and a structured failure naming the smallest reachable size, never a resize, per operator decision OD-3.
No server guard against unconfirmed names, per operator decision OD-4, because the server cannot tell a confirmed name from an invented one.
Both batch scenarios exist and replay the live bug (PED-001 and SED-004), with a second numbered folder on the FAIL list, awaiting grading in 006 because AC-005 is open.
All seven known causes of the live bug are each mapped to a landed fix, and the remaining risk is model compliance, which the ungraded scenarios exist to prove.

ruledOutDirections.approach: A second copy of the dispatcher or a duplicate CLI handler table
ruledOutDirections.reason: The placement split and error mapping would drift apart

ruledOutDirections.approach: Keeping the CLI coupled to the MCP SDK at runtime, or printing the whole CallToolResult
ruledOutDirections.reason: The SDK imports on the dispatch path are type-only and the envelope is the shape the CLI exists to avoid

ruledOutDirections.approach: Driving createServer over an in-process transport, argv sniffing in index.ts, or teaching loadConfig CLI separators
ruledOutDirections.reason: The CLI needs one dispatch and one process, and config.ts is shared with the MCP boot path

ruledOutDirections.approach: A build-time schema manifest, per-flag tool arguments, or a resident daemon
ruledOutDirections.reason: Measured startup is about a tenth of a second and the JSON object form is one parse path

ruledOutDirections.approach: Base64 previews in JSON or dropping previews from the CLI
ruledOutDirections.reason: A path is what a user needs before confirming a name, and no terminal renders base64

ruledOutDirections.approach: A baked absolute path in the skill copy or a second MCP entry for the CLI
ruledOutDirections.reason: The plugin root changes on update and the plugin registers no MCP server

ruledOutDirections.approach: npm publication or a single-file CLI bundle
ruledOutDirections.reason: The package is private and a single-file bundle relocates import.meta.url for both dist-relative reads

ruledOutDirections.approach: Splitting setup.md by surface or adding cli.md to RESOURCE_MAP or ALWAYS
ruledOutDirections.reason: A split costs a Knowledge rename and a kernel resync, and a skill-only resource breaks every differential fixture

ruledOutDirections.approach: Reusing the tools route value for a CLI run or adding a CLI mode
ruledOutDirections.reason: The route value is the machine-checkable statement of which transport answered, and mode is the media type

ruledOutDirections.approach: Retiring the SRO-001 and PRO-001 twin or keeping the route assertion inside it
ruledOutDirections.reason: The identical prompt on both surfaces is the check the packagings agree, and a paired route assertion would fail once transports differ

ruledOutDirections.approach: A hard server guard against unconfirmed names or a soft omission warning
ruledOutDirections.reason: The server cannot tell a confirmed name from an invented one, and neither shape has request identity

ruledOutDirections.approach: Multi-input image_convert in place of targetFolder or maxBytes as a hard guarantee
ruledOutDirections.reason: One placement primitive fixes every writing tool, and at some quality floor the byte target is unreachable
